message: Thymeleaf template name comes from request input (SSTI)
fix: Use a fixed template name; pass user data only as model attributes

message: RequestDispatcher target comes from request input
fix: Dispatch to a fixed set of internal views

message: EL expression created from a dynamic string and evaluated
fix: Never build value expressions from user input; use fixed logic

message: Apache HttpClient request URI comes from request input (SSRF)
fix: Allowlist destination hosts or map the parameter to known endpoints

message: File written to a path derived from request input
fix: Resolve under a fixed root and reject '..' components

message: Hessian binary deserialization of untrusted data
fix: Do not deserialize Hessian data from outside the trust boundary

message: JWT built or verified with the 'none' algorithm (signature bypass)
fix: Pin the allowed algorithms to the expected HMAC/RSA ones

message: Multipart upload saved via transferTo without content validation
fix: Generate a server-side name, validate type/size, store outside the web root

message: Cookie set without HttpOnly (readable from JS / XSS theft)
fix: Call cookie.setHttpOnly(true)
fail:
Cookie c = new Cookie("sid", id);
c.setHttpOnly(false);
pass:
Cookie c = new Cookie("sid", id);
c.setHttpOnly(true);

message: Cookie set without the Secure flag (sent over cleartext)
fix: Call cookie.setSecure(true)
fail:
Cookie c = new Cookie("sid", id);
c.setSecure(false);
pass:
Cookie c = new Cookie("sid", id);
c.setSecure(true);

message: CORS configuration allows credentials (dangerous with wildcard origins)
fix: Combine credentials with an explicit origin allowlist only
fail:
CorsConfiguration cfg = new CorsConfiguration();
cfg.setAllowCredentials(true);
pass:
CorsConfiguration cfg = new CorsConfiguration();
cfg.setAllowedOrigins(List.of("https://example.com"));

message: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA1 used as the password KDF
fix: Use PBKDF2WithHmacSHA256 with a high iteration count
fail: SecretKeyFactory f = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("PBKDF2WithHmacSHA1");
pass: SecretKeyFactory f = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("PBKDF2WithHmacSHA256");

message: RSA with PKCS#1 v1.5 padding (padding oracle risk)
fix: Use RSA/ECB/OAEPWithSHA-256AndMGF1Padding
fail: Cipher c = Cipher.getInstance("RSA/ECB/PKCS1Padding");
pass: Cipher c = Cipher.getInstance("RSA/ECB/OAEPWithSHA-256AndMGF1Padding");

message: Spring HttpInvokerServiceExporter exposed (Java deserialization endpoint)
fix: Remove the exporter; use a JSON API instead

message: World-writable file permissions set
fix: Grant the minimum owner/group permissions required

message: Regex compiled from request input (ReDoS via catastrophic backtracking)
fix: Constrain the pattern, cap input length, or precompile a fixed pattern

message: DES key in use (56-bit, broken)
fix: Use AES-GCM with a 256-bit key
fail: DESKeySpec dks = new DESKeySpec(passwordBytes);
pass: SecretKeySpec key = new SecretKeySpec(aesKeyBytes, "AES");

message: HMAC-MD5 used (weak MAC)
fix: Use HmacSHA256 or stronger
fail: Mac mac = Mac.getInstance("HmacMD5");
pass: Mac mac = Mac.getInstance("HmacSHA256");

message: ThreadLocalRandom used where a CSPRNG is required (predictable tokens)
fix: Use SecureRandom for tokens, nonces, and keys
fail: int token = ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(1000000);

message: WebClient URI comes from request input (SSRF)
fix: Allowlist destination hosts or map the parameter to known endpoints
